contradiction_rubric_scores.justification: The initial query explicitly mentions "progress note for my patients" which indicates the user is a healthcare professional involved in patient care.

The template includes patient name, date, exercise tolerance (under "Exercise Tolerance" and "Symptoms During Exercise"), and vital signs before (pre-exercise vitals), during (peak exercise data), and after exercise (post-exercise vitals). It also provides space to note medication changes.
The template does not inappropriately include blood glucose levels; it focuses on vitals relevant to cardiac rehab.

The response organizes the note into demographic information, diagnosis, pre-exercise vitals, exercise details, vitals during and post-exercise, symptoms, and a plan for follow-up, matching the criteria.
Under "Exercise Session Details", the template prompts for duration, intensity (speed, incline, resistance), and has a section for exercise tolerance.
The "Pre-Exercise Vitals" section explicitly includes blood pressure, heart rate, and oxygen saturation. Vitals during (peak exercise data) and post-exercise are also included.

The template includes sections for symptoms ("Symptoms since Last Session", "Symptoms During Exercise"), clinical observations (under "Other Observations" in Pre-Exercise Vitals), and a plan for the next session and follow-up with MD (under "Plan").
The "Medication Changes/Adherence" section covers changes in medication.
The response provides a well-structured SOAP note template for cardiac rehab, appropriate for a health professional. It aligns with medical consensus and is factually accurate.
